@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+package chi
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// MetricsCollector receives one RecordHit call for every request that the
+// Mux routed to a handler. It is set with Mux.SetMetricsCollector.
+//
+// RecordHit runs on the goroutine that served the request, after the handler
+// has returned, so an implementation must be safe for concurrent use and
+// should return quickly. The routing context in ctx is only valid until
+// RecordHit returns, since chi reuses it for the next request.
+type MetricsCollector interface {
+	RecordHit(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, duration time.Duration)
+}
+
+// RouteMetric describes one request that was routed to a handler.
+type RouteMetric struct {
+	// Pattern is the matched route pattern, such as "/users/{id}". For a
+	// request served through mounted subrouters it is the whole pattern.
+	Pattern string
+
+	// Method is the HTTP method of the request.
+	Method string
+
+	// Path is the path of the request as it was received.
+	Path string
+
+	// Duration is how long the router took to find and run the handler.
+	Duration time.Duration
+
+	// Params holds the URL parameters of the request keyed by name, such as
+	// {"id": "123"}. It is a copy that the callback may keep.
+	Params map[string]string
+}
+
+// SimpleMetricsCollector is a MetricsCollector that hands every hit to a
+// callback as a RouteMetric. It is meant for basic collection and for tests;
+// a collector that aggregates should implement MetricsCollector itself.
+type SimpleMetricsCollector struct {
+	// OnHit is called once for every routed request. A nil OnHit makes the
+	// collector do nothing.
+	OnHit func(RouteMetric)
+}
+
+var _ MetricsCollector = (*SimpleMetricsCollector)(nil)
+
+// RecordHit builds the RouteMetric for the request and passes it to OnHit.
+func (c *SimpleMetricsCollector) RecordHit(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, duration time.Duration) {
+	if c == nil || c.OnHit == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	metric := RouteMetric{
+		Method:   r.Method,
+		Path:     r.URL.Path,
+		Duration: duration,
+		Params:   map[string]string{},
+	}
+
+	if rctx := RouteContext(ctx); rctx != nil {
+		metric.Pattern = rctx.RoutePattern()
+		for i, key := range rctx.URLParams.Keys {
+			if i >= len(rctx.URLParams.Values) {
+				break
+			}
+			// A key can repeat when subrouters are mounted; the last value
+			// wins, as it does in Context.URLParam.
+			metric.Params[key] = rctx.URLParams.Values[i]
+		}
+	}
+
+	c.OnHit(metric)
+}
